title: 9xbuddy: Video downloader
summary: Download media, manage files, and organize links in one simple workspace.
description:
Fast. Private. Organized. ⚡🔒

⚠️ Note: This app does not support downloading from YouTube in accordance with Google Play policies.

9xbuddy is an all-in-one video downloader, download manager and file manager — built for people who save media often and want everything in one organized place.

Paste a link, pick from the available formats, and let the download run. Finished files land in your Library, where you can search, sort, group and find them again in seconds.

This is not just a basic downloader. 9xbuddy is built for real downloading needs — fast, private, reliable, and designed for frequent use.

🔗 ONE LINK, MORE POSSIBILITIES
• Paste or type a link from any supported platform
• See every format the page offers, with its size, resolution, codec and frame rate
• Preview and play a format before committing to the download
• One-click download straight at your preferred quality
• Search the web or enter a URL from inside the app

📚 YOUR LIBRARY — EVERY FILE IN ONE PLACE
Finished downloads land in your Library automatically, so nothing gets lost in a folder you forget about.
• Every finished file in one place, in list or grid view
• Search and sort your whole library instantly
• Group files into your own collections — nothing moves on disk
• Mark favourites for the files you come back to
• Set custom thumbnails and album artwork
• Full history of every extraction, download and edit, with filters
• Save to internal storage, SD card, USB drive, or any folder you choose
• Custom filename patterns, and files added to the system Downloads folder so other apps can see them

📥 A REAL DOWNLOAD MANAGER
• Playlist and channel downloads in one run
• Bulk import from CSV / TXT, or paste many links at once
• Pause, resume, cancel and retry any transfer — one by one or all at once
• Auto-retry failed downloads on a schedule, with your own attempt limits
• Parallel downloads, multiple connections per file, and a total speed limit
• Background downloads with finish and failure notifications
• Clipboard watching — copy a link and 9xbuddy catches it
• Backup extractor that switches engines automatically if the first one fails

🌍 1000+ SUPPORTED SITES
Browse and trigger downloads from 1000+ supported sites without leaving the app.
• Built-in browser — open a page and download from it directly
• Sign in once in the browser for members-only or paywalled content you're authorised to access
• Import a cookies.txt file, or set custom headers per domain
• Proxy support for extraction and network routing

🎵 AUDIO, SUBTITLES AND EDITING
• Extract audio tracks and download subtitles alongside supported videos
• Choose audio track, caption language, bitrate and codec
• Convert a downloaded file to MP3
• Trim video or extracted audio to exact timestamps, with fade in and out
• Download in the highest available resolution — no quality caps

🔒 PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No email. No password. Just a private UID created in one tap.
A UID is auto-generated for your account with zero personal data attached.
All data stays on your device. No analytics, no tracking, no unnecessary collection.
Use the same UID to carry your account across devices.

🎨 MADE YOUR WAY
• Dark, light and system themes, with true black for OLED screens
• Accent colours
• 19 languages
• Compact or comfortable layouts
• In-app support tickets when you need help

🎯 GREAT FOR
Creators • Students • Researchers • Media teams • Offline library builders • Fr

9xbuddy brings video downloading, link saving and file organization into one pr life feels less scattered.

Download what you need. Manage it simply. Stay organized.

Fast. Private. Organized. ⚡🔒
